        offs.append(len(pdf)); pdf.extend(f'{n} 0 obj\n'.encode()+s+b'\nendobj\n')
    obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
    obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
    obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 8 24] /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>')
    obj(4,f'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 8 /Height 24 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length {len(jpg)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+jpg+b'\nendstream')

    obj(5,f'<< /Length {len(content)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+content+b'endstream')
    xref=len(pdf); pdf.extend(f'xref\n0 6\n0000000000 65535 f \n'.encode())
    for o in offs: pdf.extend(f'{o:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode())
    pdf.extend(f'trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 6 >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n'.encode())
    Path(out).write_bytes(pdf)

        # remove terminal stuffed 0xff? just append EOI marker
        data += b'\xff\xd9'
